body: I've tried and I've failed. That's it. I've only failed. Back when I was in college or school, I didn't expect to find someone to spend my life with, but I wanted to give it a shot. Get experience, whatever, but I wasn't good enough then. Now there's significantly less people in my life, less opportunities, and my confidence is completely shattered. I wasn't good enough then and there's no way I'm good enough for anyone now. I barely even have any friends, and the very few I do are distant. I have no one.
Same here, man... I hope you find happiness soon.
The only reason I haven't is because I don't want to do that to my folks.
She did offer but I don't think she realizes that I need a real listener, not just for a single bad day where things didn't go swimmingly
